caption: The drawing depicts three elongated, curved surfaces arranged side by side against a plain background, each illustrated with detailed linework in shades of brown, sepia, and black. The left surface features a group of four human figures, with two standing adults in the foreground clad in garments and hats, another adult seated to the left, and a small child held by the seated adult; this scene is bordered at the upper edge by a triangular patterned band. The central surface shows a single unclothed person with a pointed hat seated on a rock or log, facing left, with one arm raised toward their mouth; to their right is a large leafy plant with visible stems and leaves, and the band with a triangular pattern also appears at the top. The right surface presents a woman with detailed facial features and long wavy hair partially covered by draped fabric, sitting with her head turned slightly to the left and her hands resting in her lap; her garment appears loose, and the top edge again displays the triangular decorative band. The background is light and untextured, and the drawing is signed at the lower right with “full size P. Ward.”
title: Scrimshaw
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
